title: Mughal Deception to Draw the Singhs Out

blocks.text: The Mughal cordon tightened around the fort and stopped the supply of provisions until hunger and confusion began to work in the attackers’ favor. Inside, Banda Singh did not open the doors or answer every demand, and the garrison was forced to weigh endurance against a ruinous siege.

Mughal officers then proposed a deceitful solution: they would issue a special royal proclamation, promise safe conduct, restore lands, and feed those who came out. The real design was to lure Sikhs into the open and kill Banda Singh's followers to reduce their number before a final assault on the fort.

The page also hints that counterfeit Sikhs and court agents helped spread these promises among the besieged. What sounded like mercy was a calculated ruse meant to break the Panth by hunger, misinformation, and selective slaughter.
